JIRA DUPLICATE-COMMENT CLEANUP DONE — filed and executed as `darkish-enormous-raptors` (`76b2-4b5f-5682-45e5`), linked discovered_from this bug. This addresses this ticket's last AC ('decide and document the remediation for the ~5000 duplicate comments already in REB-1861 and the duplicates in the other 27 affected issues'); it does NOT address the code fix, which is owned separately.

29,931 duplicate Jira comments deleted across 27 of the 30 affected issues, following the mechanism established by `bd80-0603-7d44-4d9f`: candidate only if the PRE-STRIP rendered ADF text carries RECONCILER_MARKER, dedup key = `outbound_comments._normalize_comment_body` reused verbatim, keep the OLDEST copy of each distinct body, single-copy bodies and all non-candidates never deleted, full backup + fetched-equals-reported-total completeness gate before any DELETE.

REB-1861 is out of the cap: 5000 -> 79. REB-1580 2943 -> 45. Every affected issue now holds exactly one copy of each distinct body and is far below 5000, so comment sync can land again once the loop is fixed.

Independently verified per issue against the pre-deletion backups: 0 distinct bodies lost, 0 non-candidate comments touched.

The reconcile-bridge workflow remains PAUSED — do not re-enable it before the dedup fix lands, or it will re-inflate these issues.

Two findings for this bug's benefit:
1. The damage was larger than this ticket's estimate: 31,683 Jira comments against 836 distinct bodies across 30 issues (not just REB-1861). REB-1580 (2943), REB-1829 (2521) and REB-2823 (2107) were all well on their way to the cap.
2. 836 comments were bot echoes with NO marker — the outbound 32767-char truncation cuts off the trailing marker paragraph. Filed as `unreal-empathetic-illadopsis` (`5931-78a3-95d2-44cd`). It also means the marker-based loop-breaker is already inert for any over-long comment.
